title: R&D Engineer
description:
Job Title: R&D Engineer
Location: Franklin Park, IL
Duration: Direct Hire/Permanent position
Salary: $120k-$140k
 
As an R&D Engineer, you will lead technical programs focused on developing next‑generation thermoformed packaging products and technologies. You will own all technical activities for assigned project, driving innovation, executing development plans, and delivering packaging solutions used by many of the world’s most recognized brands.
 
The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in polymer science, materials engineering, or packaging technology, combined with a passion for solving complex technical challenges.
 
.This is an onsite position based in Franklin Park, IL. Title level will be determined based on experience and business needs.
 
What you’ll be doing:
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in the processing of plastic materials for consumer packaging with a focus on portion control packaging.
  • Provide technical input and recommendations on manufacturing equipment to support current operations and future growth.
  • Address internal and external customer needs by developing packaging solutions within a manufacturing environment.
  • Lead the technical integration of projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and equipment manufacturers to solve complex problems and improve product performance in a timely, cost‑effective manner.
  • Generate new concepts that support the R&D product innovation and technology roadmap.
  • Develop and lead pilot, production, and filling/packaging trials.
  • Contribute to a motivating and engaging environment within the R&D organization.
  • Promote a positive, safe work culture through open communication and teamwork.
  • Ensure adherence to company safety policies and procedures.
  • Travel to suppliers, customers, and other innovation partners and for conferences, trade shows, or training
 
We’d love to hear from you if:
  • B.S./M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Plastics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Packaging Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a strong technical foundation in plastics manufacturing and processing (e.g., extrusion, thermoforming, tooling). Experience in consumer food packaging and/or flexible packaging is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing environment and a record of successfully leading capital projects in partnership with OEMs and suppliers.
  • Working knowledge of HIPS, PET, PP, PE resins and additives; experience with coatings and lamination of rigid sheet is preferred.
  • Strong initiative, energy, and ownership of results.
  • Curiosity and awareness of emerging technologies inside and outside the packaging industry.
  • Self‑starter with a positive, hands‑on, “can‑do” approach and the ability to work independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects (commercial, manufacturing, supply management, etc.).
  • Strong technical aptitude and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, results‑oriented environment.
  • Highly organized and self‑motivated.

title: Lean Manager
description:
Job Title:  Lean Manager
Location:  LaGrange, GA (onsite)
Duration:  Direct Hire/Permanent role
Salary:  $100k - $115k
 
Role overview:
This role will integrate lean principles to optimize processes and eliminate waste, enhancing overall operational efficiency.  In addition, this role will have a dual responsibility in developing and implementing EHS programs, ensuring compliance with regulations, conducting risk assessments, and fostering a culture of safety and continuous improvement. 
 
Responsibilities:
Lean Implementation: Integrating lean principles to improve processes, reduce waste, and enhance operational efficiency.
Communication and Collaboration: Facilitating communication between team members, stakeholders, and other departments. 
Continuous Improvement: Promoting a culture of continuous improvement in both EHS and lean initiatives.
Training and Development: Developing and delivering training programs for employees at all levels.
Risk Assessment and Management: Identifying potential hazards, conducting risk assessments, and implementing improvements to mitigate risks.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring the organization adheres to all applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.
Data Analysis and Reporting: Collecting and analyzing EHS data to identify trends, measure performance, and report on key metrics.
 
Specific tasks:
  • Drive lean process improvements from concept through full implementation, ensuring measurable results.
  • Lead 5S implementation, auditing, and continuous improvement initiatives to sustain workplace organization and efficiency.
  • Establish, implement, and maintain standardized processes aligned with performance targets and operational goals.
  • Identify and lead lean transformation projects, ensuring timely execution and achievement of deliverables.
  • Conduct lean assessments and audits to establish baselines, track progress, and uncover improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain the lean roadmap, providing clear monthly reporting on progress, outcomes, and key insights.
  • Conduct risk assessments, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor safety policies, programs, and regulatory compliance efforts.
  • Deliver safety training, lead safety committee activities, and promote employee awareness of safety procedures.
  • Manage environmental responsibilities, including waste reduction and regulatory compliance.
  • Maintain safety records, monitor PPE, supplies, and ensure emergency preparedness through planning and drills.
 
About you:
  • Enjoy a fast-paced professional team environment
  • Team Builder: Building trust and rapport through leading by example with integrity and accountability.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Understanding your own emotions and those of others, managing emotions effectively, and building strong relationships.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues
  • Knowledge of Industry Standards: Familiarity with relevant industry standards and regulations.
  • Attention to Detail: Accuracy and attention to detail are crucial in this role
  • Communication Skills: Effective communication skills are needed to interact with colleagues, customers and management.
  • Research Skills: Ability to effectively and efficiently gather, analyze, and interpret information to answer a question or solve a problem.
  • Organizational Skills: Organized and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
 
Professional experience and background:
Educational Background: A bachelor’s degree in business or a related field is required. Master’s degree is preferred.
Certification: Six Sigma Black Belt preferred and Certified Safety Professional (CSP) preferred.
Experience: 5 plus years of experience. 
Technical Skills: Advanced Microsoft Office skills; Dynamics FO ERP.

title: Service Billing Coordinator (HVAC)
description:
Job Title: Service Billing Coordinator (HVAC)
Location: Elk Grove Village, IL
Job Type and Duration: Direct Hire
Pay range: $70,000 - $80,000
 

Position Summary

The Service Billing Coordinator is a key financial and administrative support role, responsible for the accurate and timely billing of service and construction work and for the health of the accounts receivable ledger across multiple operating entities. This position owns the full service and construction billing cycle—from converting completed work orders, time-and-material tickets, and project milestones into invoices, through to collections and cash application. The ideal candidate is highly organized and detail-oriented, understands how service and construction jobs are costed and billed, and is confident following up on outstanding balances with clients in a fast-paced field-operations environment.

 

Responsibilities

Service & Construction Billing

• Prepare, review, and issue accurate invoices for service calls, time-and-material work, and construction project billings in accordance with contract terms, work orders, and agreed schedules of value.

• Process and reconcile billing across service calls, maintenance agreements, and construction projects, including progress billings, AIA-style pay applications, schedules of value, and retainage.

• Coordinate with field technicians, project managers, and dispatch to gather labor hours, materials, change orders, and job-completion data required for accurate billing.

• Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies or client disputes promptly and professionally.

• Track change orders and contract modifications to ensure all approved scope changes are captured and billed.

• Maintain up-to-date billing records and ensure all transactions are accurately entered and coded to the correct job or work order in the accounting or service management system.

• Own the Invoice batch panel in Service Titan, Ensuring that all Service invoicing is completed on a weekly basis.


Billing & AR Reporting

• Generate and distribute scheduled and ad hoc reports, including billing summaries, service history, contract utilization, and project billing status.

• Customize report formats to meet individual client preferences and contractual reporting requirements.

• Ensure accuracy and timeliness of all client-facing data and communications.

• Respond to client and internal inquiries related to invoices, billing statements, pay applications, and account status for both the Construction and Service Departments.

 


Required Qualifications

Education

• Associate's degree or higher in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field; OR equivalent work experience.

• High school diploma or GED required as a minimum.


Experience

• Minimum 2 years of billing, invoicing, or accounts receivable experience, preferably in a service, construction, or field-operations environment.

• Familiarity with construction billing concepts—progress billing, AIA pay applications, schedules of value, retainage, lien waivers, and change orders

• Experience generating and presenting reports using software tools or spreadsheets.

• HVAC/Service Billing/Service & Parts invoicing background is a MUST

title: Packaging Design Engineer
description:
Job Title: Packaging Design Engineer
Location: Dekalb, IL
Job Type and Duration: Direct Hire/Permanent
Pay range: $85k - $100k
 
The Design Engineer will lead the design and development of thermoformed packaging products, transforming customer requirements into manufacturable, high-performance packaging solutions. This role emphasizes creative product design, tooling design, cross-functional collaboration, and risk mitigation to ensure the successful commercialization of products.
 
What you’ll be doing:
 
  • Design thermoformed packaging products from concept through production using CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks).
  • Translate customer specifications and performance requirements into innovative packaging designs.
  • Develop detailed 3D models, assemblies, and 2D drawings for packaging products.
  • Design and develop production thermoform tooling and seal tooling to support efficient, high-quality manufacturing.
  • Utilize 3D scanning and 3D printing technologies to support prototype development, design validation, and rapid iteration.
  • Evaluate and select materials aligned with performance, sustainability, and cost objectives.
  • Conduct design feasibility studies, including draft analysis, stackability, and structural integrity of thermoformed parts.
  • Collaborate with sales, project management, and manufacturing teams to ensure product and tooling designs are practical, efficient, and manufacturable.
  • Collaborate closely with Tool Design Engineering to develop a comprehensive understanding of production tooling requirements and capabilities, and cross-train to support integrated design-to-tooling solutions.
  • Participate in customer meetings to understand needs, present design concepts, and refine solutions.
  • Support prototype development and validation, including coordinating sample production and testing.
  • Identify potential design, material, or process risks early in the project lifecycle, and proactively develop solutions to mitigate these risks through critical thinking and effective communication.
  • Ensure designs comply with industry standards, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines relevant to food and retail packaging.
  • Maintain organized, accurate design documentation and manage design revisions through PDM/PLM systems.
  • Stay current with new materials, design trends, and technologies relevant to the thermoformed packaging industry.
This position is located in DeKalb, IL and 100% onsite
  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Packaging Engineering, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in packaging design, preferably thermoformed or plastic packaging.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD software (SolidWorks strongly preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of design principles for thin-gauge thermoformed packaging, including draft angles, wall thickness, and undercuts.
  • Understanding of material properties relevant to PET, HIPS, PVC, or similar plastics.
  • Familiarity with production tooling processes, with the ability to integrate packaging and tooling design considerations with manufacturing requirements.
  • Ability to identify potential risks during design and commercialization phases, and develop effective mitigation strategies.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with an eye for design aesthetics and functionality.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

description:

Pay rate: $58-$65hr W2
US Citizenship or PERM RESIDENT - REQUIRED
Work hours: 8am-5pm
Work days: Mon-Fri

Senior Mechanical Engineer - Advanced Manufacturing

Job Description
Our client is looking for an amazingly talented Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team supporting industrial manufacturing, production facilities, and complex building environments. This role blends process/manufacturing plant experience with commercial HVAC and equipment layout responsibilities, supporting projects from early feasibility through detailed design, construction, commissioning, and startup.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Lead mechanical engineering scope for production and manufacturing facilities, including process equipment, utilities, and balance of plant systems.
• Support commercial HVAC system design for industrial, manufacturing, and ancillary building spaces, including offices, control rooms, labs, warehouses, and support facilities.
• Develop and review mechanical engineering deliverables across all project phases (feasibility, FEL 1/FEL 2, detailed design, and construction support).
• Design, specify, and integrate manufacturing process equipment and mechanical systems, including piping systems, pumps, compressors, heat exchangers, material handling systems, and industrial utilities.
• Develop HVAC system layouts and equipment selections, including air handling units, chillers, boilers, exhaust systems, and specialty ventilation based on operational and code requirements.
• Perform mechanical equipment and system layout, ensuring adequate access for operations and maintenance, coordination with other disciplines, and constructability.
• Perform engineering calculations and analyses, including HVAC load calculations, hydraulic and pressure drop calculations, ventilation analysis, and equipment sizing.
• Establish mechanical design criteria in coordination with process, architectural, operations, maintenance, safety, and client stakeholders.
• Prepare and review technical documentation, including equipment datasheets and specifications, P&IDs, HVAC and piping layouts, Basis of Design documents, technical memoranda, and construction packages.
• Coordinate with process, electrical, instrumentation and controls, civil, structural, and architectural disciplines to deliver integrated, compliant designs.
• Support vendor engagement and procurement, including technical bid evaluations, vendor drawing reviews, and factory acceptance testing, as required.
• Participate in operability, maintainability, reliability, and constructability reviews for both manufacturing systems and building mechanical systems.
• Ensure compliance with applicable codes and standards, including ASHRAE, ASME, NFPA, OSHA, IMC, and owner standards.
• Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers and designers.
• Support construction, commissioning, and startup activities, including field support and issue resolution.
• Champion safety, quality, and reliability throughout all phases of project delivery.

Required Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
• 8+ years of mechanical engineering experience.
• Demonstrated experience in operating manufacturing or production plant environments.
• Proven experience with commercial HVAC systems and mechanical equipment layout.
• Ability to work effectively within multi-disciplinary engineering teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have Skills
• Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain.
• Experience with brownfield facility modifications in active plants.
